name: Full Potential Assessment — Life lens (7 Areas)
doctrine: core/STATE/ACADEMY/ACADEMY_PATTERN.md — ONE front door, life lens. Allocation Score 0-100 = mean of 7 area means × 10. Lowest area = default practice target.

areas.label: Physical
scored: How well is your body supporting what you want to do today? (energy, sleep, movement)
How consistent has your sleep / movement / nutrition been this week?
areas.context: What's one physical signal your body is sending you right now?

areas.label: Mental
scored: How clear is your thinking right now — decisions feel easy vs. foggy?
How much unresolved mental clutter (open loops, unmade decisions) are you carrying? (0 = drowning in it, 10 = clear)
areas.context: What's the one thought loop that's taken up the most bandwidth this week?

areas.label: Spiritual
scored: How connected do you feel to a purpose/AIM bigger than today's to-do list?
How often this week did you feel meaning/alignment vs. just going through the motions?
areas.context: Name your current highest AIM in one sentence.

areas.label: Social
scored: How supported do you feel by the people around you right now?
How many real (non-transactional) conversations did you have this week? (0 = none, 10 = daily)
areas.context: Who is one person you could build something with right now?

areas.label: Emotional
scored: How regulated do your emotions feel day to day (vs. reactive/overwhelmed)?
How honest have you been with yourself about how you actually feel this week?
areas.context: What emotion have you been avoiding looking at?

areas.label: Financial
scored: How much control do you feel over your money (vs. money controlling you)?
How aligned is your spending with what you say you value?
areas.context: Name one thing you value above money.

areas.label: Environmental
scored: How much does your physical environment (home, workspace, nature access) support your full potential?
How sustainable / aligned do you feel your footprint is?
areas.context: What's one thing in your environment you'd change first?

rescore_loop.formal: Day 0 and Day 14 only — full 21-question instrument. Day0→Day14 delta = the official reportable metric.
rescore_loop.daily: Days 1-13: Ember classifies each 30-sec voice note to one area, applies bounded ±1 nudge (floor 0, ceiling 10, max one nudge/area/day). Directional coaching signal only — never the graded number.
